newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: PRICE WATERHOUSE STATE COMMERCIAL BANK BID.
newsitem.headline: PRICE WATERHOUSE STATE COMMERCIAL BANK BID.

text.p: Lithuania's finance ministry said on Tuesday that it had picked the Vilnius office of Price Waterhouse to oversee the evaluation of the troubled State Commericial Bank ahead of its privatisation.

"In keeping with its stated goal of privatising the State Commericial Bank, the ministry of finance has selected Price Waterhouse to complete an evaluation of the bank," the ministry said in a statement.
"Price Waterhouse was selected after keen competition from all of the locally based international accounting firms," it said.
"The ministry has chosen an aggressive time-table, and expects to select the winning bidder (for the bank's privatisation) in the first part of July," the ministry said.
The State Commerical Bank is the first of Lithuania's three big state banks slated for privatisation.
The bank had a staggering loss last year of over 170 million litas stemming from a staggering bad loan portfolio.
